hero_subtitle: I help startups, scale-ups and SMEs implement artificial intelligence — from audit and roadmap to working solution and team adoption.
about_intro: Product and technology executive with 10+ years of experience in AI, digital products and business transformation.
about_body: I bridge the gap between business goals and technical execution — something most consultants can't offer. My work is backed by real experience: launching 10+ AI solutions in production, scaling digital products to millions of users, and leading strategy from Series C fundraising to team restructuring.
about_location: Based in Tarragona, Catalonia. Working remotely across Spain and the EU.

about_creds.d: Executive roles building and leading product organisations, most recently as Director of AI in a European neobank.
Shipping from zero inside small teams, and running products used by millions — one business unit grown 1.5× to a nine-figure revenue run-rate.
Chatbots and internal assistants, customer support, document and back-office processing, quality and risk monitoring — all running in production, not in demos.

about_highlights: Director of AI, Finom — built the AI function from scratch in a European neobank, launched 10+ AI solutions including agentic systems. Participated in $100M+ Series C fundraising.
Director of Products, Tinkoff — led B2B2C unit with 10M+ MAU and 1,000+ partners. Grew annual revenue 1.5× to $100M.
Mentor at GoPractice — teaching product management in AI/ML to managers across the industry.
MIPT graduate — Applied Physics, Mathematics & Computer Science + MSc in Venture Capital & Tech Entrepreneurship.
services_subtitle: From audit to implementation — I cover the full cycle so you don't need to hire a team.

services.title: AI Consulting & Audit
services.description: Analyse your business processes, identify automation opportunities, prioritise by ROI. Deliverable: an AI implementation roadmap with tools, timeline and expected impact.

services.title: AI Solution Development
services.description: Design and build LLM-based solutions: assistants, chatbots, support agents, RAG systems, CRM integrations. Tools: Python, Anthropic/OpenAI APIs, cloud infrastructure.

services.title: AI Process Automation
services.description: Set up AI tools and no/low-code automations — document processing, email assistant, content generation, data analysis agents. Configured for your workflow, ready to use independently.

services.title: AI Quality Analytics
services.description: Build evaluation sets, quality dashboards (resolution rate, CSAT, LLM-as-judge, error rate, latency), production data analysis and feedback loop for continuous improvement.

services.title: Digital Product Consulting
services.description: Implement product processes (discovery, delivery, OKR, roadmaps), guide new product launches. Available as fractional CPO / Head of AI for early-stage teams.

services.title: Team Building & Training
services.description: Build and restructure cross-functional teams, run AI/ML product management workshops and mentoring sessions. Deliverable: trained team, working methodology, materials.

why_items.title: Full-cycle: strategy to implementation
why_items.description: Most consultants do one or the other. I cover the full cycle — from audit and roadmap to working solution and team adoption — so nothing falls through the cracks.

why_items.title: AI in production, not demos
why_items.description: Customer support automation, intelligent chatbots, AI agents for repetitive workflows, recommendation engines, document processing, accounting automation — real applications built and running in production.

why_items.title: Measurable results, not just tools
why_items.description: Every engagement starts with the business problem. Each stage has a clear deliverable and a measurable objective. The client receives a solution they can use independently.

why_items.title: Current tech stack
why_items.description: LLMs, RAG, agentic systems — the approaches that are just now reaching SMEs. Early adoption is your competitive edge, and I make it accessible.
